title: quercus phellos var. pumila
intro: Quercus phellos var. pumila, commonly known as the dwarf willow oak, is a small tree or shrub that is native to the southeastern United States and is characterized by its small size and narrow, pointed leaves. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus phellos var. pumila include its ability to relieve coughs and reduce inflammation, making it a useful remedy for individuals suffering from respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
